name: s81hd_lane_m-s81hd_lane_m-COMMIT
purpose: S81.HEAD: head-die lane block (safe8_ntf lane + static core adapter) to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0). SAFE review in kit README.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81hd_lane u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DOT_COLL_NATIVE32 -DOT_COLL_NATIVE32_OFF --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/link/ot_link_crc32.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay_tree3.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/coll/ot_s81ph_ckbuf.sv rtl/lib/ot_sram_oldread_b64.sv rtl/lib/ot_sram_showahead_b64.sv rtl/common/ot_link_credit_rx_b64.sv rtl/common/ot_link_credit_tx_rc.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_link_ep_safe4.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_link_gbx_safe3.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/coll/ot_s81ph_coll_lane_safe4.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_head/ot_s81hd_util.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_head/ot_s81hd_lane.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81hd_lane_m/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81hd_lane_m/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81hd_lane_m --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81hd_lane --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w2c_256x64_m1 --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w2c_32x64_m1 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: HD-CTLGATE (S81-HEAD 10-21): NEW head-die lane block ot_s81hd_lane (13 per head die: 6 TP4 mesh, 2 host, 5 draft) as a FLAT leaf = dsfd_coll_lane_w_safe8_ntf (the S81-COLL s8nr/s8nq lane structure: same sources, defines, 55-SRAM macro map, W SerDes face, k-means regional CTS) + the static core adapter (valid-only core side, bit-sliced 3-flit TX buffer + credit sender, always-accept RX, sticky would-overflow faults). Outline 812.16 x 583.2 = s8nr body + 86.4-um E adapter band; SerDes pins (rx/tx) on W, core pins (tx_d/rx_d/v/flt/ck/rst_n/chb) on E; K=32 regional roots. MAIN.
